bagPolicy.summary: Lambeau Field allows clear bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" and small non-clear bags up to 4.5" x 6.5". All other bags are prohibited. Security measures include walk-through metal detectors.
allowed: clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12" x 6" x 12"
small non-clear bags up to 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: still photo cameras with lenses over 12"
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: All parking spaces in the lots surrounding Lambeau Field are sold out to holders of season parking passes. Individual game parking is available through PMI in nearby lots, and free parking can be found on residential streets. Accessible parking is available for $50 on a first-come, first-served basis.

rideshare.note: Meet your driver at Mike McCarthy Way and Holmgren Way. Use a main gate on the east or south side to walk to the pickup point.

concessions.note: The Green Bay Packers and Delaware North Sportservice have introduced new concession items for the 2022 season at Lambeau Field. These offerings aim to enhance the game-day experience with diverse food and beverage options.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Those who utilize a wheelchair to maneuver the concourse but are able to view the game from a standard stadium seat can store their wheelchair at one of the two Guest Services booths located underneath Section 109 in the main concourse and underneath Section 353 in the upper concourse.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: For Packers games, there is no exit and re-entry for afternoon games. For games at 6 p.m. or later, you can leave the Atrium and return only if your ticket is exit scanned at the American Family Insurance Gate between six and four hours before kickoff. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For Packers games, will call is at the main ticket office on the northeast side of the stadium, facing Lombardi Avenue next to the Miller Lite Gate, which also handles lost or stolen tickets. Packers home games require a mobile ticket for entry. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For Packers games, all gates open two hours before kickoff and are accessible. If your seat is in the South End (section numbers ending in "s"), use the Potawatomi Sportsbook Gate; otherwise use the gate listed on your ticket. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
